description.value: Shun Fa Noodle House is an authentic, inexpensive Chinese restaurant on Victoria Drive offering a broad menu spanning noodle soups, hot pot rice, and Chinese specialty plates. The kitchen is known for house-made desserts — tofu pudding, bubble waffles, and osmanthus cake — all prepared fresh daily. Catering and takeout are both available, giving cyclists a flexible option for a sit-down meal or food to go.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 97m. Total: 2 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is available and confirms this is an active Chinese restaurant at 5763 Victoria Dr, Vancouver. The catering page states 'Pick up only' and the tofu pudding page states the item 'is available for take out', confirming takeout service; the menu explicitly labels multiple dishes 'Vegetarian'. No bike parking, water refill, washroom, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenity information appears anywhere in the website or OSM tags, so those fields are null. Two different postal codes appear on the website (V5P 3W5 in the global sitewide header vs V5X 4J6 in the location sections), which is flagged as a concern; the body-section postal code is used as it appears more deliberately placed.
concerns: Two different postal codes appear on the website: 'V5P 3W5' in the sitewide page header and 'V5X 4J6' in the dedicated location/contact sections on every subpage — the correct postal code is uncertain and should be verified.
No phone number is listed anywhere on the website despite the call-to-action 'Order By Phone'; OSM also has no phone entry.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, established sit-down restaurant with a broad menu, confirmed takeout, and multiple vegetarian options — a practical and worthwhile meal stop for touring cyclists on Victoria Drive.
